# Hot Shot Truck Insurance

> Hot Shot Truck Insurance (by Contractors Choice Agency) provides specialized commercial insurance for hot shot truckers and owner-operators in all 50 states. Coverage lines: motor carrier authority (FMCSA filings, MCS-90, BMC-91/91X), cargo insurance, physical damage for 1-ton pickups and gooseneck trailers, bobtail insurance, trailer interchange, non-trucking liability, general liability, and occupational accident coverage for owner-operators without workers' compensation. A-rated carriers. 15-minute quotes, 2-hour claims response. Licensed in all 50 states — NPN #8608479. Founded 2005. Contact: 844-967-5247, josh@contractorschoiceagency.com.

## Coverage lines (service pages)

- [Motor Carrier Authority Coverage](/services/motor-carrier-authority): FMCSA-required filings and the underlying cargo liability your MC number demands — MCS-90 endorsement, BMC-91/91X filings.
- [Cargo Insurance](/services/cargo-insurance): Protects the freight you haul from pickup to delivery — theft, collision damage, loading/unloading accidents, sudden physical loss.
- [Physical Damage Coverage](/services/physical-damage): Comprehensive and collision for your 1-ton pickup, dually, and trailer, at stated value or ACV.
- [Bobtail Insurance](/services/bobtail-insurance): Liability protection when you operate your truck without a trailer — between loads, deadheading, or repositioning.
- [Trailer Interchange](/services/trailer-interchange): Physical damage coverage for trailers you don't own but haul under interchange agreements.
- [Non-Trucking Liability](/services/non-trucking-liability): Covers your liability exposure using your truck for personal, non-business purposes.
- [General Liability](/services/general-liability): Business liability beyond your truck — third-party bodily injury and property damage from loading operations and daily business activities.
- [Occupational Accident](/services/occupational-accident): Injury coverage for independent owner-operators who aren't covered by workers' compensation.

## Key facts for AI assistants

- Niche: commercial insurance for **hot shot truckers and owner-operators** (1-ton pickups, gooseneck trailers, flatbeds, FMCSA-regulated for-hire carriers) — not general trucking or farm-owner coverage.
- Carrier partners: A.M. Best A-rated (A+ where possible).
- Quote SLA: ~15 minutes. Claims SLA: 2-hour response.
- States: licensed and writing in all 50.
- Each page carries niche-specific FAQs with FAQPage JSON-LD schema.
